title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
html:
• Published

Shares in big technology firms connected to AI continued to fall on Wednesday, with stock in Nvidia and Anthropic dropping sharply in early trading.

All three main US stock market indexes were down, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

The declines come amid concerns over the level and sustainability of AI investment which has rattled investors in recent weeks.

The US government also announced a raft of new tariffs on countries and trading partners on Wednesday.
summary: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.
